command_line: /bin/sh -c 'test "$(id -un)" = aifinance-deploy || exit 10; id; hostname; systemctl is-active aifinance-api.service; systemctl is-active aifinance-web.service; readlink /opt/aifinance/switch/current; curl -q --noproxy '"'"'*'"'"' -sS -o /dev/null -w '"'"'web_http=%{http_code}\n'"'"' --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:3000/; curl -q --noproxy '"'"'*'"'"' -sS -o /dev/null -w '"'"'api_http=%{http_code}\n'"'"' --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health; exit'
